dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: What a pleasant place this is, and there's such a nice scent in the breeze... Living here must be wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Thank you, truly, for inviting me to this place.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I like it very much.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The air is clean, the ventilation is good, and the number of plants around here is just right.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I'm sure the animals would love it here. They would say, "We are certain only a kind soul could create a cozy place like this."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The forest in your home gives me the same sort of vibe.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Does it now? I'm happy to hear that.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: I know that in the eyes of many ordinary fellows, the Frostmoon Scions are rather unique... We care more about scents, temperature, and environment than most.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Indeed, we are closer to nature and animals than others, but to fashion it another way, this also means that our senses are sharper.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hence, our decision to accept you as a friend is also a sort of... proof, shall we say.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: To seek advantage and avoid harm is the nature of all living things. That we gravitate to you is proof that you are someone who makes others feel very safe.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And that's something very important. Please never forget it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Would you like to have a chat with me?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Of course. Would you like me to think of a topic?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hmm... However, I am not exactly the sort of person that can carry a conversation... I believe that much about myself.

choices.text: Hardly! You're very good at talking to others, Lauma.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: I'm sorry to disappoint you... It is because of my duties that I must speak those words of comfort and encouragement.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Words carry a wondrous power, so people tend to say whatever is appropriate to a conversation. I am no different.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Now that we're on the subject, I suppose I would like to become a more proficient communicator...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You can always learn from your friends.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: ...Ah, yes. Ms. Nefer, Mr. Varka, and Mr. Flins come to mind.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: They are all clever and wise individuals. Having come from different backgrounds, their ways of speech also differ.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Meeting them has shown me the extent of my abilities. I still have much to learn.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: But maybe there's a lot they can learn from you in return.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Hmm... You're right, I suppose there might be.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: At least in terms of communicating with animals, I know I definitely have the upper hand.

choices.text: It's alright. I'm not much of a talker either.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Oh, hardly... I've seen the way you talk to others. You're doing just fine.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Although Paimon often speaks in your stead, I find your words often fascinating. I've been paying special attention to them, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: There are, but perhaps not right now.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: There are some beautiful forests in Nod-Krai that rarely see visitors, so I like to go to such places and rest when I am free.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Perhaps it's because of the extraordinary blood that flows through my veins... I am always concerned with matters such as the cleanliness of the water and the gentleness of the breeze.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: And that is also why I have less time to truly relax compared to others.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Only in places such as those can I truly forget my frustrations. Soaking in the water and daydreaming... Why, sometimes I lose focus, and slip into my six-limbed form...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Six limbs? That would be a rare sight indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hehe, indeed. Life is easier with more limbs to work with...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Ah, do forgive me. We seem to have talked ourselves onto a rather unorthodox tangent.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Is that so? What a relief.

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: It truly pays to befriend those who have seen much of the world.

choices.text: Does it feel weird to have six limbs?

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: No, I'm used to it by now. Besides, sprinting with four legs simply means an advantage in speed. Once you experience it, it's hard to go back to anything else.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: No wonder you sometimes just forge ahead without looking back...

response.speaker: Lauma
response.text: Yes, it is as you say. I have made quite the habit out of sprinting around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good morning, Lauma.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: #Good morning, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The forest will surely protect a kind soul like you. Venture forth freely.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good night, Lauma.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: May the stars be the guardian of your dreams, and of your journey home.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Rest well. Good night.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Hmm... Seeing as no one else is here, may I share something private with you?

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Sometimes I wonder if the Frostmoon Scions are a little too taken with antler and moon imagery...

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: The furnishings are beautiful, certainly, but you have to take care to avoid getting your hair or clothing caught in them.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: A warm light, like that of home... I like it here.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Moments of peace like this are perfect for curling up with a book and reading in silence.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: But just for today, let us not read any Frostmoon Scion texts. Rather, let us find something more interesting to read. Quietly, of course.
